label: Proper-part extensionality and simple plurality control checked
meaning: All minimal objects have empty strict lower cones. For composites with the same strict lower cone, strong supplementation of a failure of containment would supply a separating part: if strict it also lies below the other object, and if equal to the whole a shared strict part witnesses overlap. Either case contradicts disjointness, yielding mutual containment and identity. Reuse atomicModel and strongOfComplementation on Body; its two singleton atoms witness failure of unrestricted extensionality. This is a premise-free control showing the two extensionality senses cannot be substituted for one another.
